method: historical rolling holdout, model refit using only past rows for each target index; min 100 earlier draws, future rows excluded
method_versions: top18 of K22 balanced into 3 sixes
disjoint: original three mains plus three top-ranked non-overlapping rows
caveats: Retrospective testing on a model family conceived using overlapping historical draws, not independent prospective proof
